run_convert_dance_diffusion: run the script to convert a dance diffusion model checkpoint to diffusers format with --model_path and --checkpoint_path
rename_orig_weights: rename original model state dict keys to match diffusers UNet1DModel naming conventions
download_model_ckpt: download a dance diffusion model checkpoint file from the MODELS_MAP URL by model name
get_crash_schedule: compute the crash noise schedule timesteps from a tensor of values between 0 and 1
transform_conv_attns: transform convolutional attention weights into linear attention weights by splitting qkv projection matrices
